prompt:

A distinct face and costume from the other elf portraits.
Three-quarter view, head centered with margin for avatar cropping, torso and natural hand included. Fine slightly irregular umber outlines, short hatch clusters under brow and jaw, hair recesses and overlapping fabric. Hair described as larger flowing locks with few interior lines, not individual hairs. Clothing mostly light cream paper with shadows beneath folds and a few small dark brown pockets. Warm muted brown only on very pale ivory paper, faint sparse sketch marks behind shoulders fade to blank background. No scenery, text, border, watermark, smooth blended tonal shading, skin pores, dense microtexture, gray graphite wash, solid color fills or thick cartoon contours. One character only, square final 640x640 profile.
